topics.label: Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the students, reviews connections to practicals, and outlines the learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Tumor Viruses and Assaying Cellular Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of tumor viruses led to the discovery of cellular proto-oncogenes and established experimental assays to test cellular transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, Tumor Suppressors, and Cell Cycle Control
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the major classes of cancer-associated genes and explain how mutations disrupt cell cycle regulation and protein function.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how defects in DNA repair, replication, and chromosome segregation generate genetic instability and drive multi-step tumor progression.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how inherited germline mutations predispose individuals to cancer and shape subsequent tumor evolution.

topics.label: Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture by referencing the learning outcomes, recommending reading, and looking ahead to the next session.
